description: From e-governance and education to startups and ethical AI, the policy outlines how the state plans to translate national AI goals into citizen-level outcomes.
body_lead: Chief Minister Bhajanlal Sharma launched the Rajasthan AI-ML Policy 2026 and the National AI Literacy Programme at the Rajasthan Regional AI Impact Conference 2026 held at JECC, Jaipur. The event also saw the launch of the iStart Learning Management System, the Rajasthan AI Portal, and the Rajasthan AVGC-XR Portal. The AI-ML Policy 2026 outlines the state’s approach to adopting AI and machine learning (ML) in a structured, responsible, and secure manner. The Rajasthan AI-ML Policy 2026 seeks to strengthen e-governance by integrating AI into public service delivery.
